instruction: Look at freecad_task-12_input.step in FreeCAD. Use the Part Design workbench and GUI Body workflow, but keep this multi-body task as ten separate Bodies or solids; activate or create the needed Body for each element, create new sketches for sketch-based features, and do not fuse the final solids. Use the single calibration cube as the seed for a multi-body inspection gauge compound; the final STEP must intentionally contain ten separate solids, not one fused solid. Create five separate rectangular gauge blocks arranged as a staircase along X, each 18 x 18 mm in plan, bottom at Z=0, with heights 10,16,22,28,34 mm and X origins 0,24,48,72,96 mm. Also create five separate vertical cylindrical pins on a diagonal row at centers (12,42), (42,50), (72,42), (102,50), and (132,42). Their diameters must be 10,11,12,13,14 mm and their heights 18,21,24,27,30 mm respectively. Do not fuse the ten bodies; export them together as a compound STEP /home/user/Desktop/freecad_task-12_output.step. Use GUI operations only and do not create external script files.
